title: Performance-CBOM v0.1 (CycloneDX-compatible binding)
description: Validates the P-CBOM overlay on a CycloneDX cryptographic-asset component. This is the interoperability contract. It checks ONLY the P-CBOM-specific constraints; the host document must independently validate against the stock CycloneDX 1.6+ schema. The record is carried as namespaced entries in the component's 'properties' array (CycloneDX's sanctioned name/value extension point), because 'component' and 'cryptoProperties' are additionalProperties:false and cannot hold a custom nested key. Algorithm identity comes from cryptoProperties.algorithmProperties and is not duplicated by the extension.

assetType.description: v0.1 binds to algorithm assets. protocol reserved for v0.2.

properties.description: CycloneDX name-value properties. MUST include the required P-CBOM reference tuple as namespaced entries.
